apps.name: Youbot
apps.description: A self-hosted AI concierge for visitors. Set it up with Youbot's guide.

editorial.reason: Give visitors a helpful first response while keeping control of the information and channels Youbot can use.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial download
An AI provider must be configured before conversations work
Use Youbot's own installer until PicoRunner supports its setup
editorial.availability: Youbot's installer creates a private owner login and keeps its app and data in your user folder. PicoRunner does not yet run or manage that installer.
legalNotes: The README labels the project MIT, but a license file could not be verified at the reviewed commit. Check the upstream project for its current licensing terms.
Connected messaging services and configured AI providers receive the information needed for the requests you send through them.

evidence.summary: The public repository has no root package manifest. Its recommended installer writes a separate user-scoped Youbot installation and launcher outside PicoRunner's managed app directory.

paragraphs: Youbot is a self-hosted AI concierge that helps visitors using the information and boundaries its owner supplies. The owner configures the concierge, connects supported channels, follows visitor conversations, and takes over when a decision or personal reply is needed. Channel integrations and available actions depend on configuration and authorization.

apps.name: Flourish
apps.description: Track spending, savings, investments, and loans in a private finance workspace.

editorial.reason: Bring everyday money records into one local workspace, with imports you can review before saving.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial download
Flourish has no built-in account system; keep it on your Mac or behind a private network

evidence.summary: The public package manifest declares Flourish and a dev script. It specifies pnpm 10.29.3 and Node.js 22.22 or newer.
The project documents local startup and SQLite storage. A full PicoRunner install, open, and restart check has not been recorded.

paragraphs: Flourish is a self-hosted personal finance workspace for everyday spending, savings goals, investments, loans, and recurring payments. Your financial data stays in a local SQLite database.
features: Bank, cash, and credit-card accounts
Monthly spending patterns and six-month trends
Savings goals and contribution history
Investment holdings, valuations, and cash flows
Review-before-save imports for CSV, XLSX, PDF, and screenshots
Local backups, restore checks, exports, and audit history

apps.name: Rise
apps.description: Keep daily check-ins, health records, and follow-up reminders together.

editorial.reason: Keep personal records and daily changes in one place without turning missed days into failures.
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial download
Python 3.11 or newer is needed for Rise's local API
legalNotes: Rise is a record-keeping tool, not a medical service. It does not diagnose, interpret results, recommend treatment, or replace professional care.

evidence.summary: The public root package is Rise and declares a dev script that starts its local API and web interface.
The project documents Node.js and Python requirements and local startup. A full PicoRunner install, open, and restart check has not been recorded.

paragraphs: Rise is a self-hosted wellness journal for daily check-ins, measurements, health records, medications, appointments, and follow-up reminders. It records what you enter without treating missing days as failures or offering medical advice.
features: Daily fasting, weight, blood pressure, pulse, activity, and sleep check-ins
Configurable trackers with history and corrections
Medication schedules and as-needed dose logs
Appointments and follow-up reminders
A mobile-friendly interface and installable web app
Local SQLite storage

Smooth fade transitions on play/stop and sleep timer shutdown.

Presets to save, rename, delete, and instantly reapply mixes.
Built-in binaural beat and isochronic tone generators.
Built-in breathing exercise, Pomodoro, countdown, todo, and notepad tools.
Installable PWA with offline caching.

apps.name: OpenResume
apps.description: Create a professional resume, import an existing resume PDF, and export your updated document.

editorial.reason: Make a resume with a live PDF preview and a dedicated import and export workflow.
editorial.bestFor: Preparing a resume for job applications
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial dependency download
No account or cloud service is required for the documented core resume workflow.

evidence.summary: Pinned manifest declares open-resume and dev: next dev. This is source evidence, not a completed PicoRunner runtime verification.
The README describes resume creation, PDF import and export, and local development with npm. The inspected Next.js package declares the recorded dev script.
The pinned upstream repository license was checked separately from app launch compatibility.

paragraphs: OpenResume is a powerful open-source resume builder and resume parser.
OpenResume's resume builder allows user to create a modern professional resume easily.
features: The resume PDF is updated in real time as you enter your resume information, so you can easily see the final output.
If you already have an existing resume PDF, you have the option to import it directly, so you can update your resume design to a modern professional design in literally a few seconds.

apps.name: Dillinger
apps.description: Write Markdown with a live preview, local autosave, and Markdown or HTML export.

editorial.reason: Pair a focused writing surface with rendered previews and portable document exports.
editorial.bestFor: Notes and documents written in Markdown
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial dependency download
Cloud sync requires separate OAuth credentials for each provider; basic writing does not use those integrations.
PDF export uses a server-side Chromium dependency and has not been validated on macOS.

evidence.summary: Pinned manifest declares dillinger and dev: next dev. This is source evidence, not a completed PicoRunner runtime verification.

The README documents npm installation and the dev script, local autosave, and Markdown/HTML export. Cloud integrations require OAuth configuration. Its Chromium-based PDF export is not included in this compatibility prediction.
The pinned upstream repository license was checked separately from app launch compatibility.

paragraphs: A modern, cloud-native Markdown editor built on Next.js — designed for speed, focus, and seamless sync.
features: Monaco Editor (VS Code core)
Syntax highlighting for Markdown
Image paste support
Real-time preview
Scroll sync
Auto-save (local persistence)
Fullscreen, distraction-free writing

apps.name: Scratch
apps.description: Create interactive stories, games, and animations by arranging visual programming blocks.

editorial.reason: Let learners experiment with characters, sounds and interactive behavior using a visual editor.
editorial.bestFor: Learning through interactive stories and games
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 13.5 or later
Internet connection for the initial dependency download
The repository specifies Node.js 24.21.0; use a PicoRunner release that supplies that runtime.
The editor is a large npm workspace; its first installation and build can take longer than smaller apps.
Online assets and community features may require internet access; community publishing uses a Scratch account.

evidence.summary: Pinned manifest declares scratch-editor and start: npm --workspace @scratch/scratch-gui start. This is source evidence, not a completed PicoRunner runtime verification.

The root start script delegates to the Scratch GUI workspace, whose README documents npm start and the editor. The repository specifies Node.js 24.21.0; workspace preparation runs during dependency setup.
The pinned upstream repository license was checked separately from app launch compatibility.
The Scratch GUI workspace documents starting the editor with npm start; the root script delegates to this workspace.

paragraphs: This is a source code repository for the packages that make up the Scratch editor and a few additional support packages.
features: scratch-gui provides the buttons, menus, and other elements that you interact with when creating and editing a project. It's also the "glue" that brings most of the other modules together at runtime.
scratch-paint provides a way to draw vector (SVG) or bitmap (PNG) images for costumes and backdrops.
scratch-render draws backdrops, sprites, and clones on the stage.
scratch-storage helps load project assets like images and sounds.
